name: Privacy-first family travel mission taxonomy

nameLocalized.zh-Hant: 隱私優先親子旅行任務分類資料集

description: Bilingual, machine-readable observation prompts for 12 family-travel settings. The taxonomy provides 84 targets and three non-age, non-ability participation modes without requesting names, ages, destinations, locations, photos, itineraries or completion records.

descriptionLocalized.en: Bilingual, machine-readable observation prompts for 12 family-travel settings. The taxonomy provides 84 targets and three non-age, non-ability participation modes without requesting names, ages, destinations, locations, photos, itineraries or completion records.
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 適用 12 種親子旅行情境的英繁雙語機器可讀觀察提示，包含 84 個觀察目標與三種不按年齡或能力分級的參與方式，不要求姓名、年齡、目的地、位置、照片、行程或完成紀錄。

creator: Lumi Apps

methodology.en: Original observation targets were manually curated for common family-travel settings, then reviewed for privacy and situational safety. Official references support the stated safety boundaries; they do not endorse this dataset.
methodology.zh-Hant: 針對常見親子旅行情境人工策劃原創觀察目標，再進行隱私與情境安全檢查。官方資料僅支援所列安全界線，不代表官方認可本資料集。

limitations.en: This is a prompt taxonomy, not child-development guidance, a safety certification or a substitute for current local, venue, carrier, crew, ranger or supervising-adult instructions. Suitability depends on the actual setting and participant.
limitations.zh-Hant: 本資料集是提示分類，不是兒童發展指引、安全認證，也不能取代當下當地、場館、運輸業者、機組員、巡護員或陪同大人的指示；是否適用仍須依實際情境與參與者判斷。

promptTemplate.en: From your current spot, notice {target}. Point only when the setting permits and your supervising adult has said it is safe; never ask a driver to look.
promptTemplate.zh-Hant: 從目前位置觀察「{target}」。只有在情境允許且陪同大人已確認安全時，才從原地指出來；絕不要求駕駛查看。

promptTemplate.en: Notice {target}. Think of one colour, shape, sound or detail. Share only with a non-driving companion when the setting permits.
promptTemplate.zh-Hant: 觀察「{target}」，想一個顏色、形狀、聲音或細節；只有在情境允許且有非駕駛同行者時才分享。

promptTemplate.en: Use {target} as a prompt. Invent one kind question, route idea or tiny story alone or with a non-driving companion when permitted.
promptTemplate.zh-Hant: 以「{target}」為提示，自己想一個友善問題、小路線或迷你故事；情境允許時也可和非駕駛同行者一起想。

safetyBoundary.en: Use these cards at home. Adults keep control of travel documents, medicine, keys and final packing decisions.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 請在家使用這組卡片。旅行文件、藥物、鑰匙與最後打包決定，全都由大人保管與確認。

text.en: one item that helps everyone stay comfortable
text.zh-Hant: 一件讓大家旅途中更舒適的物品

text.en: one item in the adult's travel-document check
text.zh-Hant: 一件大人會檢查的旅行文件用品

text.en: one object that can be used again instead of thrown away
text.zh-Hant: 一件可重複使用而非用完即丟的物品

text.en: one quiet activity for a wait
text.zh-Hant: 一種等待時可安靜進行的活動

text.en: one colour shared by two packed items
text.zh-Hant: 兩件擁有相同顏色的行李物品

text.en: one item the adult may need to reach quickly

text.en: one way the group can help each other

safetyBoundary.en: Stay beside the supervising adult, keep paths and checkpoints clear, and follow airport and security staff. These cards never ask for photos.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 留在陪同大人身旁，不阻擋走道或安檢區，並遵守機場與安檢人員指示。這組卡片完全沒有拍照任務。

text.en: two different signs visible from your current waiting spot
text.zh-Hant: 從目前等待位置看得到的兩種標誌

text.en: a vehicle seen through a window
text.zh-Hant: 一台從窗戶看得到的車輛

text.en: one repeating shape in the building
text.zh-Hant: 建築裡一種重複出現的形狀

text.en: one colour worn by staff

text.en: an object with wheels
text.zh-Hant: 一件有輪子的物品

text.en: one quiet sound and one louder sound

text.en: one symbol that helps people find a place

safetyBoundary.en: Use only while seated and when the crew permits it. Stop for safety briefings, instructions, turbulence or whenever the adult says to pause.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 只有在坐好且機組人員允許時才使用。安全說明、任何指示、亂流，或大人要求暫停時，立即停止活動。

text.en: one shape outside the window, if your seat has a view
text.zh-Hant: 座位看得到窗外時，窗外的一種形狀

text.en: two different materials near your seat
text.zh-Hant: 座位附近兩種不同材質

text.en: one quiet sound
text.zh-Hant: 一個安靜的聲音

text.en: one object that folds
text.zh-Hant: 一件可以折疊的物品

text.en: one item the crew uses to share information
text.zh-Hant: 一件機組人員用來傳達資訊的物品

text.en: one cloud shape, if visible
text.zh-Hant: 看得到天空時，一朵雲的形狀

text.en: one polite way to help your row

safetyBoundary.en: Observe only from a correctly restrained passenger seat. The driver never reads, answers or operates these cards while driving.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 只能從正確使用安全座椅或安全帶的乘客座位觀察。行車期間，駕駛絕不閱讀、回答或操作卡片。

text.en: one colour repeated on two road signs
text.zh-Hant: 兩個道路標誌上重複出現的一種顏色

text.en: a bridge, tunnel or overpass
text.zh-Hant: 一座橋、隧道或高架道路

text.en: one changing landscape feature
text.zh-Hant: 一項逐漸改變的地景

text.en: a vehicle carrying something unusual
text.zh-Hant: 一台載著特別物品的車輛

text.en: one safe rest-stop detail
text.zh-Hant: 一個安全休息站裡的細節

text.en: one cloud or weather clue
text.zh-Hant: 一個雲朵或天氣線索

text.en: one landmark the adult points out
text.zh-Hant: 一個由大人指出的地標

safetyBoundary.en: Follow the operator and supervising adult. Stay behind marked lines, use seats or handholds as directed, and never approach an edge for a card.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 遵守運輸業者與陪同大人的指示，留在標線內，依指示使用座位或扶手；絕不為了卡片靠近月台或船邊。

text.en: one arrival or departure sign
text.zh-Hant: 一個抵達或出發標誌

text.en: one repeated seat or railing pattern
text.zh-Hant: 一種重複出現的座椅或欄杆圖案

text.en: one sound that signals movement
text.zh-Hant: 一個表示移動開始的聲音

text.en: one object used by staff
text.zh-Hant: 一件工作人員使用的物品

text.en: one view that changes as you travel
text.zh-Hant: 一個旅途中逐漸改變的景色

text.en: one safe handhold pointed out by the adult
text.zh-Hant: 一個由大人指出的安全扶手

text.en: one way passengers make space for each other
text.zh-Hant: 一種乘客彼此留出空間的方法

safetyBoundary.en: Use a card only after the adult chooses a safe place to stop. The adult handles navigation, crossings, traffic and decisions about where to walk.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 只有在大人選定安全停留處後才使用卡片。導航、過馬路、車流與行走路線，全部由大人判斷。

text.en: one old building detail
text.zh-Hant: 一個老建築的細節

text.en: one new building detail
text.zh-Hant: 一個新建築的細節

text.en: one symbol used for crossing or directions
text.zh-Hant: 一個用於過馬路或指路的符號

text.en: three colours on one block
text.zh-Hant: 同一街區裡的三種顏色

text.en: one tree, planter or public garden
text.zh-Hant: 一棵樹、一個花台或一座公共花園

text.en: one detail above eye level

text.en: one place where people pause

safetyBoundary.en: Follow the venue's current rules. Do not touch or photograph anything unless it is clearly permitted, and choose watching or stopping at any time.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 遵守場館當下規則。除非明確允許，否則不觸摸、不拍照；任何時候都可選擇只看或停止。

text.en: one object with an unexpected texture
text.zh-Hant: 一件材質觸感看起來很特別的物品

text.en: one object from another time or place
text.zh-Hant: 一件來自不同年代或地方的物品

text.en: one tiny detail in a large display
text.zh-Hant: 一個大型展示裡的微小細節

text.en: one shape repeated in two works
text.zh-Hant: 兩件作品裡重複出現的一種形狀

text.en: one question the label may help answer
text.zh-Hant: 一個展示說明可能回答的問題

text.en: one object you would protect carefully
text.zh-Hant: 一件你會小心保護的物品

text.en: one display you can describe without touching
text.zh-Hant: 一個不用觸摸就能描述的展示

safetyBoundary.en: Use only while safely stationary and when the adult permits it. Queue, ride, height, restraint and staff instructions always take priority.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 只有在安全停留且大人允許時才使用。排隊、設施、身高、安全裝置與工作人員指示永遠優先。

text.en: one design detail in the waiting area
text.zh-Hant: 等候區裡的一個設計細節

text.en: one map symbol
text.zh-Hant: 地圖上的一個符號

text.en: one object that helps staff communicate
text.zh-Hant: 一件協助工作人員溝通的物品

text.en: one colour used to guide visitors
text.zh-Hant: 一種用來引導遊客的顏色

text.en: one shaded or quiet rest area
text.zh-Hant: 一個有遮蔭或較安靜的休息區

text.en: one sound that belongs to the theme

text.en: one way the group can stay together
text.zh-Hant: 一種讓同行成員保持在一起的方法

safetyBoundary.en: Stay where the adult and local rules allow. Observe wildlife from a safe distance; do not touch, collect or feed anything for a card.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 只停留在大人與當地規則允許的地方，和野生動物保持安全距離；不為了卡片觸摸、撿走或餵食任何東西。

text.en: one pattern made by wind or water
text.zh-Hant: 一種由風或水形成的圖案

text.en: one natural object to observe without taking
text.zh-Hant: 一件只觀察、不帶走的自然物

text.en: one sign of an animal from a safe distance
text.zh-Hant: 一個從安全距離看得到的動物線索

text.en: two shades of one colour
text.zh-Hant: 同一種顏色的兩種深淺

text.en: one weather change
text.zh-Hant: 一項天氣變化

text.en: one sound you can hear without moving closer

text.en: one way to leave the place as you found it
text.zh-Hant: 一種讓環境保持原樣的方法

safetyBoundary.en: Keep room numbers, names and travel details off the cards. Respect other guests; the adult handles keys, exits and emergency information.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 卡片上不寫房號、姓名或行程資料，並尊重其他旅客。房卡、出口與緊急資訊都由大人管理。

text.en: one sign that helps find a room or exit
text.zh-Hant: 一個協助找到房間或出口的標誌

text.en: one repeating pattern in a shared area
text.zh-Hant: 公共空間裡一種重複出現的圖案

text.en: one object that saves water or energy
text.zh-Hant: 一件節省水或能源的物品

text.en: one quiet way to move through a hallway
text.zh-Hant: 一種安靜通過走廊的方法

text.en: one item the group needs before leaving the room
text.zh-Hant: 一件離開房間前同行成員需要的物品

text.en: one view from an allowed shared space
text.zh-Hant: 一個從允許使用的公共空間看得到的景色

text.en: one way to leave the room tidy
text.zh-Hant: 一種讓房間保持整齊的方法

safetyBoundary.en: Adults and restaurant staff handle allergies, food safety and movement. Do not photograph or approach other guests for a card.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 過敏、食品安全與走動方式由大人和餐廳人員處理；不為了卡片拍攝或靠近其他客人。

text.en: one ingredient named on the menu
text.zh-Hant: 菜單上寫到的一種食材

text.en: one shape repeated in the table setting
text.zh-Hant: 餐具擺設裡重複出現的一種形狀

text.en: one polite phrase the group can use
text.zh-Hant: 一句同行成員可以使用的禮貌用語

text.en: one colour shared by two foods
text.zh-Hant: 兩種食物共有的一種顏色

text.en: one item staff uses to organise service
text.zh-Hant: 一件工作人員用來安排服務的物品

text.en: one sound that signals food preparation
text.zh-Hant: 一個和準備餐點有關的聲音

text.en: one way to help clear your own space
text.zh-Hant: 一種協助整理自己座位空間的方法

safetyBoundary.en: Observe from the seat or area chosen by the adult. Never approach a stranger for a card, and skip anything that could disturb the space.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 只從大人選定的座位或區域觀察，不為了卡片靠近陌生人；任何可能打擾現場的內容都直接跳過。

text.en: one object with straight lines
text.zh-Hant: 一件有直線的物品

text.en: one object with curved lines
text.zh-Hant: 一件有曲線的物品

text.en: three things in the same colour family
text.zh-Hant: 三件屬於相近色系的東西

text.en: one nearby sound and one distant sound
text.zh-Hant: 一個近處聲音與一個遠處聲音

text.en: one object that starts with a chosen sound

text.en: one detail you did not notice at first

text.en: one tiny story about an ordinary object
text.zh-Hant: 一個以普通物品為主角的迷你故事
